Lo que debes saber de nosotros: What you should know about us
¿Cómo cotizo mi viaje?: How do I get a quote for my trip?
Cuéntanos fechas, número de personas, pu: Tell us the dates, number of people, departure and arrival points, and luggage. You can use the quote form or write to us on WhatsApp at +57 304 496 1698.
¿Cotizar es lo mismo que reservar?: Is getting a quote the same as booking?
No. La cotización no confirma una reserv: No. A quote does not confirm a booking. We first review the experience, dates and number of travelers with you; then you confirm with the team.
Sí, es nuestra propuesta: tours 100% pri: Yes, that is our proposal: 100% private tours, with an exclusive guide-driver, a private vehicle and no mass groups. Schedules are flexible; the conditions of each tour are confirmed when you request a quote.
En las fichas: transporte privado, vehíc: On each tour page: private transport, comfortable vehicles, professional drivers and guides, personalized attention, and photos and videos of the tour. Confirm stops, tickets and meals in your proposal before booking.
En la mayoría de experiencias, con la re: On most experiences, with pickup at your hotel in Medellín. Tell us your accommodation or departure point and we will confirm the meeting place and whether there are extra costs.
¿Puedo adaptar el recorrido a mi grupo?: Can I adapt the tour to my group?
Sí, cuéntanos qué lugares quieres visita: Yes, tell us which places you want to visit, how much time you have and what you need. We will review the available options with you so it is your trip, your timing, your experience.
¿Cómo elijo entre ciudad, pueblos o natu: How do I choose between city, towns or nature?
Ciudad para historias y arte urbano; pue: City for stories and street art; towns for a change of pace; nature to look up close. Check travel times before filling the schedule and tell us your preferences.
¿Cómo funciona el traslado desde el aero: How does the airport transfer work?
Coordinamos el traslado entre el Aeropue: We coordinate the transfer between José María Córdova Airport and your accommodation in Medellín, with flight tracking. Share your flight number, address and number of passengers.
¿Qué pasa si mi vuelo cambia de hora?: What if my flight time changes?
El servicio incluye seguimiento del vuel: The service includes flight tracking and we adjust the pickup according to your flight number. Waiting conditions and the meeting point are confirmed with the team.
¿Qué vehículos tienen y para cuántas per: What vehicles do you have and for how many people?
Sedán Ejecutivo (1–3), SUV Ejecutiva (1–: Executive Sedan (1–3), Executive SUV (1–4), Executive Van (1–8), Van Master (1–14), Van Sprinter (1–17) and buses (25–40). The unit and its availability are confirmed when you request a quote.
¿Atienden empresas y grupos?: Do you serve companies and groups?
Sí: puedes consultar transporte para equ: Yes: you can ask about transport for work teams, events and groups. Share schedules, routes and number of passengers so we can prepare the proposal.
¿Qué debo confirmar antes de contratar?: What should I confirm before booking?
Revisa el valor total, las inclusiones,: Review the total price, inclusions, schedule, proposed vehicle and the payment and cancellation terms with the team handling your request.
¿Qué debo preparar antes del recorrido?: What should I prepare before the tour?
Ten a la mano fecha, punto de partida y,: Have your date, starting point and, if you arrive by plane, your flight number at hand. Each tour page has its own recommendations, such as comfortable shoes for the viewpoints or a camera with space.
¿Cuál es la política de cancelación, cam: What is the cancellation, change and refund policy?
Entendemos que los planes pueden cambiar: We understand plans can change. That is why we offer rescheduling alternatives subject to availability. For cancellations we apply the following terms on the deposit received: 15 days or more in advance: 60% refund; between 8 and 14 days: 20% refund; 7 days or less: no refund. Date change requests are subject to availability and to the booking conditions.
¿Cuáles son los medios de pago, el antic: What are the payment methods, deposit and invoicing?
Para confirmar una experiencia solicitam: To confirm an experience we ask for a 30% deposit of the total price. The remaining 70% can be paid during or at the end of the experience. We have secure electronic payment links and payment options in Colombian pesos (COP). For some airport transfer services the deposit may be 50%. We issue booking certificates and provide electronic invoicing based on the data supplied by the customer.
¿En qué idiomas atienden los guías?: Which languages do the guides speak?
Nuestros servicios se ofrecen principalm: Our services are mainly offered in Spanish. We also have bilingual English-speaking guides and can arrange support in Portuguese or other languages on request and subject to availability.
¿Qué seguros y pólizas respaldan el serv: What insurance and policies back the service?
Trabajamos con vehículos de servicio esp: We work with properly authorized special-service vehicles, valid documentation and the corresponding mandatory coverage, including SOAT and insurance applicable to the contracted transport. We hold National Tourism Registry RNT 176384 and NIT 901738550-6.
¿Qué no incluye una experiencia?: What is not included in an experience?
Salvo que la cotización indique expresam: Unless the quote expressly states otherwise, our services do not include tickets to parks or attractions, personal purchases, tips or additional activities. Each commercial proposal clearly specifies the included services and the costs borne by the traveler.
¿Pueden viajar niños, bebés o mascotas?: Can children, babies or pets travel?
¡Las familias son bienvenidas! Los bebés: Families are welcome! Babies can travel at no extra cost, according to the booking conditions and the vehicle capacity. We do not have a general minimum age for experiences, although some attractions may set their own restrictions. We can also take pets, arranging their transport conditions in advance to ensure comfort and safety.
¿Hay opciones de accesibilidad o para mo: Are there accessibility or reduced-mobility options?
Buscamos adaptar nuestras experiencias a: We aim to adapt our experiences to each traveler's needs. If a passenger has reduced mobility or needs special assistance, we recommend telling us before booking so we can check the right vehicle, the tour conditions and the accessibility of the places they want to visit.
¡La experiencia no tiene por qué detener: The experience doesn't have to stop! Most of our tours can run in moderate rain. When weather conditions affect an activity, we look to adjust the itinerary or propose alternatives, always putting our travelers' safety first.
¿Cuánto esperan en el aeropuerto y cómo: How long do you wait at the airport and how do I recognize you?
Realizamos seguimiento a los vuelos para: We track flights to coordinate our passengers' arrival. Our driver contacts you beforehand and shares the meeting point instructions, as well as their details and the vehicle's. For pre-arranged services we can offer a personalized sign with the passenger's or group's name. We understand there can be delays at immigration, baggage claim or with flights, so we offer support and flexibility while you wait.
¿Cuál es el horario de atención y en cuá: What are your support hours and how fast do you answer quote requests?
Nuestra operación de transporte cuenta c: Our transport operation is available 24 hours, with prior booking. We provide personalized advice through our digital channels and WhatsApp. We do our best to answer quote requests as soon as possible, depending on our sales team's availability. Our commitment is to accompany the traveler from planning to the end of their experience.
